source_entity: SPS5.2 - Land North of Pack Lane
evidence_slice: Basingstoke and Deane Borough Council's November 2025 Regulation 18 Draft Local Plan lists Policy SPS5.2, Land North of Pack Lane, as a housing-led allocation for approximately 300 homes, including 5% serviced custom/self-build plots; the council explains the land was separated from the earlier Northern Manydown allocation because it does not yet have planning permission.
